x.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int8`, `int16`, `int32`, `int64`, `uint8`, `uint16`, `uint32`, `uint64`, `bfloat16`, `half`, `float32`, `float64`.
constraints: x must be one of int8, int16, int32, int64, uint8, uint16, uint32, uint64, bfloat16, half, float32, float64
x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes

y.description: A `Tensor`. Must have the same type as `x`.
constraints: y must have the same dtype as x
x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `x`.

constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes
